svg.title: Trinity Peaks · Four-person suite, Option B — schematic exploration v1
svg.desc: Four residents, each in a single room on the facade, sharing a suite lounge strip, two full bathrooms, a storage room, and a small study nook. 4 beds. Envelope 38'-0" by 28'-0" (1064 sf) using exploratory dimensions. Not measured, not code reviewed, not for construction.
svg.text: Trinity Peaks · Four-person suite, Option B
Four singles + two bathrooms + suite lounge
4 beds · envelope 38'-0" × 28'-0" = 1,064 sf · 266 sf per bed
SCHEMATIC EXPLORATION · v1 · 2026-11-06 · Dimensions are exploratory assumptions (studies/assumptions.json), not measurements.
Not code-reviewed, not an accessibility determination, not for construction. Orientation not established (no north arrow).
Independent student design study by Ivan Minier, drawn with AI assistance. Not a UVM design or an adopted part of the Trinity Redistricting proposal.
